tiers.smoke: Small, fast models used for first-run validation and basic test coverage.
tiers.recommended: Models that should work well on the target machine and represent the default curated experience.
tiers.advanced: Heavier or more specialized models that are supported but not part of the Milestone 1 starter catalog.

models.summary: Smallest Whisper checkpoint (39M params) for fast end-to-end offline transcription validation.
known_limitations: Lower transcription quality than larger Whisper variants.
Long-form audio should be chunked instead of processed as a single pass.
runtime_notes: Treat as the default STT smoke-test model.
Use Whisper processor-driven preprocessing.
Supports multilingual transcription and speech translation, but v1 should focus on local transcription.

models.summary: Mid-range Whisper (244M params) balancing speed and accuracy for multilingual transcription.
known_limitations: Long-form audio should be chunked into 30-second segments.
Susceptible to hallucination on silence or noisy segments.
runtime_notes: Uses standard AutoModelForSpeechSeq2Seq loading path.
Good balance between quality and resource usage for 12GB VRAM targets.
80 Mel frequency bins (same as tiny/base/medium).

models.summary: Pruned Whisper large-v3 (809M params, 4 decoder layers) — near large-v3 quality at much faster inference.
known_limitations: Uses 128 Mel bins (different from smaller variants).
Larger degradation on some languages like Thai and Cantonese vs large-v3.
Susceptible to hallucination on silence.
runtime_notes: Uses standard AutoModelForSpeechSeq2Seq loading path.
128 Mel frequency bins — processor handles this automatically.
Decoder reduced from 32 to 4 layers for significantly faster inference.
MIT licensed.

models.summary: FastConformer-TDT English ASR model used to validate first-class NeMo support.
known_limitations: English-only output.
Model card states lowercase English transcription output.
runtime_notes: Model card specifies 16000 Hz mono wav input.
Use as the default NeMo STT validation model.
Implementation should keep the NeMo loading path local-only.

models.summary: State-of-the-art 2B Conformer ASR — #1 on HuggingFace Open ASR Leaderboard (5.42% avg WER).
known_limitations: Requires explicit language tag per input — no automatic language detection.
No timestamps or speaker diarization.
Hallucination on silence — recommend VAD preprocessing.
Code-switched audio not well supported.
runtime_notes: Uses AutoModelForSpeechSeq2Seq with trust_remote_code=True for broad transformers compat.
Conformer encoder-decoder architecture with 16k BPE tokenizer.
Apache 2.0 licensed.
Trained on 500k hours of curated audio-transcript pairs.

models.summary: Lightweight Voxtral 3B for speech-to-text, audio understanding, and Q&A — fits in ~9.5GB VRAM.
known_limitations: Requires transformers >= 4.54.0.
Uses chat template format for transcription requests.
8 languages only.
runtime_notes: Uses VoxtralForConditionalGeneration from transformers.
Supports transcription mode and audio Q&A mode.
Apache 2.0 licensed.
Context length 32k tokens — up to 30 min transcription.

models.summary: Compact baseline TTS path for validating the first Transformers-based synthesis flow.
known_limitations: Requires a vocoder for waveform generation.
Requires speaker embeddings for voice characteristics.
runtime_notes: Use as the default TTS smoke-test model.
Model card examples use microsoft/speecht5_hifigan plus xvector speaker embeddings.
Implementation should keep all auxiliary assets local once downloaded.

models.summary: Multilingual Coqui XTTS model for voice cloning and 17-language synthesis at 24kHz.
known_limitations: Heavier runtime than the smoke-test TTS path.
Voice cloning should remain optional and fully local in v1.
runtime_notes: Model card advertises support for 17 languages.
Model card advertises 24 kHz output.
Treat as a first-class engine path.

models.summary: Lightweight 82M TTS with 54 voices across 8 languages — low-latency 24kHz output.
known_limitations: Exact dependency pin and local runtime setup still need to be finalized.
Language and voice handling should be catalog- and runtime-driven.
runtime_notes: Model card usage example writes audio at 24000 Hz.
Model card release table indicates 8 languages and 54 voices.
Pin the kokoro runtime dependency during implementation.

models.summary: State-of-the-art 500M TTS with zero-shot voice cloning and emotion control — 24kHz output.
known_limitations: English-only (standard model). Multilingual variant available separately.
Requires ~8-16GB VRAM.
Built-in PerTh watermarking on all generated audio.
runtime_notes: Install via: pip install chatterbox-tts
Uses ChatterboxTTS.from_pretrained(device='cuda').
Supports exaggeration (0-1) and cfg_weight (0-1) parameters for emotion control.
Zero-shot voice cloning from ~10s reference audio.
MIT licensed.
